problems.title: Count the Vowels
problems.statement:
Read one line and print how many of its characters are vowels (a, e, i, o, u, in either case).

Constraints: 1 ≤ length ≤ 10^5.

testcases.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

problems.title: Fibonacci Modulo
problems.statement:
Print the n-th Fibonacci number modulo 10^9+7, with F(0) = 0 and F(1) = 1.

Constraints: 0 ≤ n ≤ 10^18. An O(n) loop will not pass.

problems.title: Balanced Brackets
problems.statement:
Read a string of (), [] and {} and print yes if it is balanced, otherwise no.

Constraints: 1 ≤ length ≤ 10^5.
